about: #4449: the java-facade scenarios (each CICS scenario entered through the program's deployed entry point) that fail on committed equivalence ports, each case with the issue that owns the defect. tests/cobol_mainframe/test_evidence.py checks it against the evidence records.

carddemo-signon.why: the generated handleTransaction(String) / handleLink() take no COMMAREA, but COSGN00C's RETURN TRANSID(CC00) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) re-enters it with one (opaque ODO DFHCOMMAREA): every re-entry is refused

cbsa-inqacc.why: the LINK target ABNDPROC (a det port) has a stub handleLink that throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of running its level

genapp-lgupdb01.why: the LINK target LGUPVS01 (a det port) has a stub handleLink that throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of running its level
